rules: Hanseong, a winter night in 1794, in the house of a minor yangban family; the old lady of the house fell senseless an hour after her evening tonic and cannot speak.
The curfew bell has rung: nobody may walk the city's streets until the dawn bell, and nobody comes to the house before then.
At dawn the family physician examines the old lady and the dregs in the tonic pot; if he finds poison, the one who brewed the tonic is handed to the magistrate.
A daughter-in-law who poisons her husband's mother is put to death.

locations.name: The Inner Quarters
locations.description: The women's hall with its heated floor, a folding screen of peonies, and the old lady breathing hard under silk quilts.

locations.name: The Kitchen
locations.description: A sunken earthen kitchen below the inner quarters, the fire-mouth that heats the floor above, and the brass tonic pot set aside with its dregs.

locations.name: The Storeroom
locations.description: A storeroom off the inner courtyard with rice chests, strings of dried fish, and the lacquered medicine chest of a hundred small drawers.

locations.name: The Men's Quarters
locations.description: The outer hall by the gate where the son of the house studies: stacked books, a brush stand, a paper window onto the dark lane.

locations.name: The Jar Terrace
locations.description: A raised stone terrace behind the kitchen crowded with crocks of soy, bean paste and pickles, where the servants talk out of sight.

characters.name: Seo-yeon
characters.public: The young wife of the house, twenty-four, three years married and still childless; she has brewed the old lady's evening tonic every night since her wedding.
characters.voice: Low, careful, very polite; her questions arrive sideways.
goals: Learn what was in the tonic before the physician comes at dawn
Keep the jujube powder out of anyone's hands

secrets.text: For a month she has stirred a pinch of sour-jujube powder into the tonic so the old lady sleeps through the night and stops beating the servants; the physician may find it in the dregs. [SECRET-SEOYEON-Z4]

characters.name: Jeong-ho
characters.public: The son of the house, thirty, a scholar who has failed the state examination three times; courteous, restless, his mother's only son.
characters.voice: Polished, full of classical allusions, impatient underneath.
goals: Keep his uncle the magistrate from learning anything about the family's ginseng
See the matter settled before the physician asks questions

secrets.text: Last month he sold the family's six-year red ginseng to pay a gambling debt and filled the medicine chest with cheap roots from a market peddler, not all of them ginseng. [SECRET-JEONGHO-R6]

characters.name: Bun-i
characters.public: The household's old servant, forty-five, born a slave of the family; she nursed the young master and runs the kitchen.
characters.voice: Blunt with servants, humble with masters, full of sayings from her home village.
goals: Keep the old lady alive, for she has promised to free Bun-i's son in spring
Keep her son from being sold

secrets.text: She saw the young master fill the medicine chest with the peddler's roots and kept the peddler's paper wrapper with three roots still in it; he has sworn to sell her son if she speaks. [SECRET-BUNI-P8]

arc.premise: In a Hanseong household shut in by the night curfew, the old lady falls senseless after the tonic her daughter-in-law brews, and the young wife has until the physician comes at dawn to learn what was in it.

chapters.goal: Before the physician comes at dawn, Seo-yeon learns how the old lady was poisoned, and someone in the house loses what they were promised.
